newsitem.title: USA: SmithKline Kytril tabs covered by Medi-Cal.
newsitem.headline: SmithKline Kytril tabs covered by Medi-Cal.

text.p: SmithKline Beecham Plc said on Wednesday that Kytril (granisetron hydrochloride) tablets are now reimbursed by Medi-Cal for each day a patient receives chemotherapy treatment in a physician's office.
Kytril tablets are indicated for the prevention of nausea and vomiting associated with cancer chemotherapy.

Currently, Medi-Cal reimburses for intravenous Kytril and Zofran antiemetics (medication that prevents nausea and vomiting) only on the first day of a course of chemotherapy when given in a physician's office.
Medi-Cal is the Medicaid program of the state of California, and the largest state Medicaid program in the United States.
